audience: IT support teams and managed service providers who run client devices and tickets in Atera

useCases.title: Check which devices are offline or need patches
useCases.text: The AI lists agents (devices) with online status and last seen, for all customers or one, and lists the missing or installed patches of a device.

useCases.title: Review open monitoring alerts
useCases.text: The AI lists alerts (disk, CPU, availability, hardware) with severity, device, customer and linked ticket. It can filter by status.

useCases.title: Review open tickets and read their threads
useCases.text: The AI lists tickets by customer or status with priority, technician and SLA durations, and reads the comment thread of one ticket.

useCases.title: Check the hours logged on tickets
useCases.text: The AI reads the time entries on a ticket: technician, start and end, billable, on-site and rate. You can use it to prepare billing.

useCases.title: Open a ticket or update one
useCases.text: The AI opens a helpdesk ticket for an existing or new contact, or changes a ticket's title, status, type, priority, impact or technician.

useCases.title: Comment on a ticket or resolve an alert
useCases.text: The AI adds a reply or an internal note to a ticket, or marks a monitoring alert as resolved.
